## api_keys

Personal access tokens `vmx_pat_<id>_<secret>`: the id is the lookup prefix, only the secret's SHA-256 is stored.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | uuid | no |  |  |
| user_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| name | text | no |  |  |
| secret_hash | bytea | no |  |  |
| scopes | text[] | no |  |  |
| created_at | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  |
| last_used_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| expires_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| revoked_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |

Constraints:

- `api_keys_pkey`: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`
- `api_keys_scopes_check`: `CHECK (((cardinality(scopes) > 0) AND (scopes <@ ARRAY['read:health'::text, 'read:config'::text, 'write:config'::text, 'write:documents'::text, 'admin'::text])))`
- `api_keys_user_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`

## blobs

Content-addressed files in the blob volume, keyed by the SHA-256 of the uncompressed content.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| sha256 | bytea | no |  |  |
| size_bytes | bigint | no |  |  |
| stored_bytes | bigint | no |  |  |
| compression | text | no |  |  |
| key_id | text | yes |  | Encryption key reference; null when the blob is not app-encrypted. |
| refcount | integer | no | `0` |  |
| created_at | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  |

Constraints:

- `blobs_compression_check`: `CHECK ((compression = ANY (ARRAY['none'::text, 'zstd'::text])))`
- `blobs_pkey`: `PRIMARY KEY (sha256)`
- `blobs_refcount_check`: `CHECK ((refcount >= 0))`
- `blobs_sha256_check`: `CHECK ((length(sha256) = 32))`
- `blobs_size_bytes_check`: `CHECK ((size_bytes >= 0))`
- `blobs_stored_bytes_check`: `CHECK ((stored_bytes >= 0))`

## job_runs

One row per execution; outcome is null while running. Kept 90 days.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | bigint | no | `identity (always)` |  |
| job_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| attempt | integer | no |  |  |
| started_at | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  |
| finished_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| outcome | text | yes |  |  |
| error_class | text | yes |  |  |
| error_message | text | yes |  | Sanitized: no secrets, bodies or health values. |
| stats | jsonb | no | `'{}'::jsonb` |  |

Constraints:

- `job_runs_job_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `job_runs_outcome_check`: `CHECK ((outcome = ANY (ARRAY['succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text, 'rescheduled'::text, 'lease_expired'::text, 'cancelled'::text])))`
- `job_runs_pkey`: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`

Indexes:

- `job_runs_job_idx`: `btree (job_id)`

## jobs

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | uuid | no |  |  |
| kind | text | no |  |  |
| status | text | no | `'queued'::text` |  |
| connection_id | uuid | yes |  |  |
| exclusive | boolean | no | `false` |  |
| priority | smallint | no | `100` | Lower runs first. |
| run_at | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  |
| dedupe_key | text | yes |  |  |
| payload | jsonb | no | `'{}'::jsonb` | Job parameters. Never secrets, passwords or MFA codes. |
| attempts | integer | no | `0` |  |
| max_attempts | integer | no | `5` |  |
| lease_owner | text | yes |  |  |
| lease_expires_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| created_at | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  |
| started_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| finished_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| checkpoint | jsonb | yes |  | Progress saved by the handler; a re-claimed job resumes from it. Never secrets or health values. |

Constraints:

- `jobs_connection_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (connection_id) REFERENCES connections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `jobs_exclusive_check`: `CHECK (((NOT exclusive) OR (connection_id IS NOT NULL)))`
- `jobs_kind_check`: `CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['sync'::text, 'backfill_unit'::text, 'normalize_batch'::text, 'reprocess'::text, 'rebuild_aggregates'::text, 'extract_document'::text, 'export'::text, 'backup'::text, 'import_unit'::text, 'prune_retention'::text, 'sweep_blobs'::text, 'recompute_local_dates'::text])))`
- `jobs_lease_check`: `CHECK (((status <> 'running'::text) OR ((lease_owner IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL))))`
- `jobs_pkey`: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`
- `jobs_status_check`: `CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'running'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text, 'dead'::text, 'cancelled'::text])))`

Indexes:

- `jobs_active_dedupe_idx`: `UNIQUE btree (dedupe_key) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'running'::text]))`
- `jobs_claim_idx`: `btree (priority, run_at) WHERE (status = 'queued'::text)`
- `jobs_connection_idx`: `btree (connection_id, created_at)`
- `jobs_one_exclusive_running_idx`: `UNIQUE btree (connection_id) WHERE ((status = 'running'::text) AND exclusive)`

## measurements

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | bigint | no | `identity (always)` |  |
| user_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| metric_id | smallint | no |  |  |
| kind | text | no |  |  |
| start_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| end_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| tz_offset_min | smallint | yes |  |  |
| local_date | date | no |  |  |
| value | double precision | no |  | In the metric's canonical unit. |
| source_value | double precision | yes |  | Original value and unit, only when conversion changed the value. |
| source_unit_id | smallint | yes |  |  |
| provider_id | smallint | no |  |  |
| connection_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| device_id | uuid | yes |  |  |
| origin_id | uuid | yes |  |  |
| group_id | bigint | yes |  |  |
| external_id | text | yes |  |  |
| dedupe_key | bytea | no |  | First 16 bytes of SHA-256 over the versioned key string (data-model.md#identifiers-and-dedupe-keys). |
| quality_flags | integer | no | `0` | Bitset defined in code: manual_entry, motion_context, implausible, relayed, migrated_without_raw, prorated_source. |
| raw_payload_id | bigint | yes |  | Null only for rows migrated without raw (quality flag). |
| normalizer_version_id | integer | no |  |  |
| ingested_at | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  |
| normalized_at | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  |
| superseded_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| superseded_by | bigint | yes |  |  |
| deleted_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| deleted_by_raw_id | bigint | yes |  |  |

Constraints:

- `measurements_connection_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (connection_id) REFERENCES connections(id)`
- `measurements_dedupe_key_check`: `CHECK ((length(dedupe_key) = 16))`
- `measurements_deleted_by_raw_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (deleted_by_raw_id) REFERENCES raw_payloads(id)`
- `measurements_device_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)`
- `measurements_end_check`: `CHECK ((((end_at IS NULL) = (kind = 'sample'::text)) AND (end_at >= start_at)))`
- `measurements_group_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES measurement_groups(id)`
- `measurements_kind_check`: `CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['sample'::text, 'interval'::text, 'cumulative'::text, 'daily_value'::text])))`
- `measurements_metric_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (metric_id) REFERENCES metric_catalog(id)`
- `measurements_normalizer_version_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (normalizer_version_id) REFERENCES normalizer_versions(id)`
- `measurements_origin_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (origin_id) REFERENCES data_origins(id)`
- `measurements_pkey`: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`
- `measurements_provider_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (provider_id) REFERENCES providers(id)`
- `measurements_raw_payload_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (raw_payload_id) REFERENCES raw_payloads(id)`
- `measurements_source_check`: `CHECK (((source_value IS NULL) = (source_unit_id IS NULL)))`
- `measurements_source_unit_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (source_unit_id) REFERENCES units(id)`
- `measurements_superseded_by_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (superseded_by) REFERENCES measurements(id)`
- `measurements_tz_offset_min_check`: `CHECK (((tz_offset_min >= '-1080'::integer) AND (tz_offset_min <= 1080)))`
- `measurements_user_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)`

Indexes:

- `measurements_daily_value_idx`: `btree (user_id, metric_id, local_date) WHERE ((kind = 'daily_value'::text) AND (superseded_at IS NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))`
- `measurements_dedupe_idx`: `UNIQUE btree (dedupe_key) WHERE (superseded_at IS NULL)`
- `measurements_deleted_by_raw_idx`: `btree (deleted_by_raw_id) WHERE (deleted_by_raw_id IS NOT NULL)`
- `measurements_group_idx`: `btree (group_id) WHERE (group_id IS NOT NULL)`
- `measurements_ingested_at_brin`: `brin (ingested_at)`
- `measurements_metric_start_idx`: `btree (user_id, metric_id, start_at) WHERE ((superseded_at IS NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))`
- `measurements_raw_payload_brin`: `brin (raw_payload_id)`
- `measurements_superseded_by_idx`: `btree (superseded_by) WHERE (superseded_by IS NOT NULL)`

## metric_catalog

Metrics owned by internal/catalog. Sources combine only when they share a code.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | smallint | no | `identity (always)` |  |
| code | text | no |  |  |
| unit_id | smallint | no |  |  |

Constraints:

- `metric_catalog_code_check`: `CHECK ((code ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$'::text))`
- `metric_catalog_code_key`: `UNIQUE (code)`
- `metric_catalog_pkey`: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`
- `metric_catalog_unit_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (unit_id) REFERENCES units(id)`

| blocked_until | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |

- `provider_rate_state_provider_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (provider_id) REFERENCES providers(id)`

## providers

Data vendors and transports. Seeded by migrations; read-only for the app role.

| code | text | no |  |  |

## raw_payloads

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | bigint | no | `identity (always)` |  |
| user_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| connection_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| batch_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| stream | text | no |  |  |
| external_key | text | no |  |  |
| version | integer | no | `1` |  |
| content_sha256 | bytea | no |  | Content hash and blob key: the verbatim payload is the blob. |
| content_type | text | no |  |  |
| fetched_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| stored_at | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  |
| request_meta | jsonb | no | `'{}'::jsonb` | Sanitized request (endpoint, params); never tokens. |
| shape_fingerprint | text | yes |  |  |
| status | text | no | `'stored'::text` |  |
| supersedes_id | bigint | yes |  | Previous version of the same (connection, stream, external_key); null for version 1. |

Constraints:

- `raw_payloads_batch_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES ingest_batches(id)`
- `raw_payloads_connection_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (connection_id) REFERENCES connections(id)`
- `raw_payloads_content_sha256_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (content_sha256) REFERENCES blobs(sha256)`
- `raw_payloads_pkey`: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`
- `raw_payloads_status_check`: `CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['stored'::text, 'normalized'::text, 'normalize_failed'::text, 'quarantined'::text])))`
- `raw_payloads_supersedes_check`: `CHECK (((version = 1) = (supersedes_id IS NULL)))`
- `raw_payloads_supersedes_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (supersedes_id) REFERENCES raw_payloads(id)`
- `raw_payloads_user_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)`
- `raw_payloads_version_check`: `CHECK ((version > 0))`
- `raw_payloads_version_key`: `UNIQUE (connection_id, stream, external_key, version)`

Indexes:

- `raw_payloads_batch_idx`: `btree (batch_id)`

## recovery_codes

Single-use TOTP recovery codes; only the SHA-256 of each 80-bit code is stored.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| user_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| code_hash | bytea | no |  |  |
| created_at | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  |
| used_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |

Constraints:

- `recovery_codes_pkey`: `PRIMARY KEY (user_id, code_hash)`
- `recovery_codes_user_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`

## schedules

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | uuid | no |  |  |
| connection_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| stream | text | no |  |  |
| run_interval | interval | no |  |  |
| lookback | interval | no | `'00:00:00'::interval` |  |
| next_run_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| enabled | boolean | no | `true` |  |
| mode | text | no | `'incremental'::text` | incremental follows the cursor; correction re-fetches the lookback window ending at each slot. |

Constraints:

- `schedules_connection_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (connection_id) REFERENCES connections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `schedules_connection_id_stream_mode_key`: `UNIQUE (connection_id, stream, mode)`
- `schedules_correction_lookback_check`: `CHECK (((mode <> 'correction'::text) OR (lookback > '00:00:00'::interval)))`
- `schedules_lookback_check`: `CHECK ((lookback >= '00:00:00'::interval))`
- `schedules_mode_check`: `CHECK ((mode = ANY (ARRAY['incremental'::text, 'correction'::text])))`
- `schedules_pkey`: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`
- `schedules_run_interval_check`: `CHECK ((run_interval > '00:00:00'::interval))`

Indexes:

- `schedules_due_idx`: `btree (next_run_at) WHERE enabled`

## users

The owner account. No signup; created by `vitamux admin create-owner`.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | uuid | no |  |  |
| username | text | no |  |  |
| password_hash | text | no |  | argon2id PHC string. |
| totp_ciphertext | bytea | yes |  | Sealed TOTP secret (internal/crypto format, purpose credentials). |
| totp_key_id | text | yes |  | Master key id of totp_ciphertext, for rotation. |
| created_at | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  |
| updated_at | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  |
| totp_enabled_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  | Set when enrolment is confirmed; a sealed secret without it is a pending enrolment. |
| totp_last_step | bigint | yes |  | Last accepted TOTP time step; a code is accepted only for a later step (no replay). |

Constraints:

- `users_check`: `CHECK (((totp_ciphertext IS NULL) = (totp_key_id IS NULL)))`
- `users_pkey`: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`
- `users_totp_enabled_check`: `CHECK (((totp_enabled_at IS NULL) OR (totp_ciphertext IS NOT NULL)))`
- `users_username_key`: `UNIQUE (username)`
